text: One cube at the centre of each face has just one painted side. There are six faces, so there are six such cubes altogether.

Order the five values: two, three, five, nine and thirty-one. The middle value, five, is the median. Their sum is fifty, so the mean is ten. Now take away the five. Four values remain, with three and nine in the two middle positions. For an even number of values, average those middle two. Three plus nine is twelve. Half of twelve is six, the new median.
A mean lets you rebuild a total. For a median, put the values in order. Use the middle value if there is one, or average the middle two.
